subject: Film & Cinema
title: Jean-Luc Godard: The Permanent Rebel
description: Learn Jean-Luc Godard: The Permanent Rebel in one minute.

hook.text: Godard said a film needs a beginning, middle, and end — but not necessarily in that order.

buildup.text: Breathless reinvented editing with jump cuts that broke every existing filmmaking rule.

discovery.text: He turned films into essays — mixing politics, philosophy, and pop culture in one frame.

twist.text: His later work became so radical that even admirers struggled to follow him.

climax.text: Godard never stopped experimenting, making films into his nineties.

punchline.text: He broke cinema's rules and never apologized.

quiz.question: What filmmaking convention did Breathless break?
options: Continuous editing — Godard pioneered the jump cut
